arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA GIVE RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) HAS COME

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: KABR SE BE SAR BAHATTAR, TAN UTHE TAAZIM KO\nDEKH ISTEKBAAL KO HAY, FURAAT-O -SHAMSHIR BHI
english translation text: FROM THE GRAVE, 72 HEADLESS BODIES RISE IN RESPECT\nLOOK, EVEN THE RIVER EUPHRATES AND THE SWORD HAVE COME TO RECIEVE HER

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: BAAPKE HATHO PE HAY, MASUM AGHER TISHNALAB\nDEKH AB TAK HAY NISHANI, HURMALA KE TIR KI
english translation text: IN THE ARMS OF HIS FATHER, THE INNOCENT BABY ASGHER (A.S) LAYS WITH THIRST\nTILL NOW THE MARKS OF HURMALA'S ARROW CAN BE SEEN ON HIM

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: KAIDSE CHHUTKER HAI AATA, KAAFELA ZAWWAR KA\nPUCHHLE UNSE SITAM, ZINDAAN KI JAAGIR KA
english translation text: HAVING BEEN FREED FROM CAPTIVITY, THE CARAVAN OF PILGRIMS COMES\nASK THEM OF THE ATROCITIES THEY FACED IN THE PRISONS

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: KAALE MEHMIL ME HAI BAITHI, BIBIYA SAB DUKH JAIL\nDAAGOSE CHHALNI JIGAR HAI, SHAAH KE HAMSHIR KI
english translation text: SITTING IN BLACK CARRIERS (ON THE BACKS OF CAMELS), ARE THE GRIEF STRICKEN LADIES\nTHEIR HEARTS ARE PIERCED WITH THE PAIN OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S)

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: KAID HOKER JAB CHALITHI, SARPE CHAADAR BHI NA THI\nSAR KHULE BAZZAR ME THI WAARISE TATHIR KI
english translation text: WHEN IMPRISONED, THE LADIES WERE WITHOUT THEIR VEILS\nBAREHEADED IN THE BAZAAR WERE THE INHERITOR OF PURITY (AS REFERRED IN THE VERSE OF TATHIR)

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: LAASH THA BEGOR BHAI, KA BAHEN SAR NANGE THI\nBHAI HAY AB KABR MEI, PARDE MEI HAY HAMSHEER BHI
english translation text: A BROTHERS BODY LAY WITHOUT A SHROUD, A SISTER WITHOUT HER VEIL\nTHE BROTHER NOW IS BURIED, THE SISTER IN HER VEIL

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: AJ TAK RONEKI BEWON, KO IJAZAT BHI NATHI\nAB RIHAAI MILGAYI, HOGI AZA SHABBIR KI
english translation text: UP UNTIL NOW THE WOMENFOLK WERE NOT EVEN PERMITTED TO CRY\nNOW THAT THEY HAVE BEEN FREED, THEY WILL WHOLEHEARTEDLY MOURN THE MARTYRS OF KERBALA

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: NANNISI TURBAT YE ASGHAR, KI CHUPAALE KERBALA\nKYA TARAPNA SOON SAKOGE, MAADARE BESHIR KA
english translation text: OH KARBALA, HIDE THIS SMALL BODY OF ASGHER A.S\nHOW WILL YOU BEAR TO HEAR THE SORROWFUL CRIES AND TORMENT OF THE THIS BABY’S MOTHER

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: MAADARE AKBER BHI AATI, HAI KALEJA THAAM KAR\nWO GILAA KISSE KARE, RUTHI HUI TAKDIR KI
english translation text: APPROACHING WITH A HAND ON HER HEART, IS THE DEVASTATED MOTHER OF ALI AKBER WITH WHOM CAN THIS POOR MOTHER SHARE HER PAIN AND GRIEF

arabic text: KERBALA TAAZIM KAR, AAI BAHAN SHABBIR KI\nJAAKE KADMOSE LIPAT, TU ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KI
english translation text: OH KARBALA SHOW YOUR RESPECT, THE SISTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAS COME\nFALL TO HER FEET AND EMBRACE THE GRIEF STRICKEN ZAINAB (A.S)

arabic text: TUM SAKINA KO NA DHUNDHO, TURBATE ABBAS PAR\nREH GAYI HAI SHAAM ME, WO LAADLI SHABBIR KI
english translation text: DON'T LOOK FOR SAKINA NEAR THE GRAVE OF ABBAS (A.S.)\nTHAT BELOVED DAUGHTER OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) IS LEFT IN SHAAM
